feature_acceptance.integration_contract: The opt-in game BeginScene/Present QPC fields, immutable frame ID/run generation and host verified-bundle actual XR submission identity are correlated only for diagnostics. Default-disabled instrumentation never selects frames or changes D3D9Ex/host GPU ACK, OpenXR ordering, synchronization or rendering ownership. Cached XR submissions do not count as new game frames. Missing/invalid timings are -1; QPC CPU durations are not native FPS evidence. Controller alone fast-forwards TARGET_BRANCH after the final feature candidate has passed preflight, then checks exact target SHA gate jobs/steps and downloadable game/host/collector artifact before C6.
